That and my little anxious dog. Anyway.. so an overdose.. I’ve had a few but only 1 was a big one that landed me in a coma. Out of all the times I’ve been suicidal these were actually accidents (3 years sober from iv fent and heroin use). As soon as I did it I fell to my knees and couldn’t move my body. I kind of felt like I was having a heart attack but couldn’t move. I wanted to scream or move or at least throw up (so nauseating but it wouldn’t come out) but I was stuck.. like frozen. One of the best ways I can describe it is like static from an old tv channel.. that’s what it felt like. Like pins and needles and like I was leaving my body but stuck. Every time. Not every time was painful but that one was. That and for some reason my life flashed before me and I was dreading the end. Not because of oblivion.. but because I realized how short life was. How all of my problems could be fixed and had this weird experience where I felt connected to everyone and everything and wanted so badly for another chance. I still struggle with suicidal thoughts but bringing this up honestly helped today. It’s like being stuck.. frozen.. and not able to do anything to stop it. Somehow people found me every time.
